extraction: AVFoundation AVAssetReader decoded frames with exact presentation timestamps; full-resolution lossless PNG exports; no generated/interpolated frames. Contact sheets only scale the frame images and add external timestamp labels.

cardTopMeasurement.method: For each full-resolution decoded PNG, sum absolute two-row luminance differences across the exposed right-hand card band x=990...1110 at step 3, then find the strongest vertical gradient in y=490...585. The band remains outside the drawer throughout these sampled movements.
cardTopMeasurement.finding: All 16 selected consecutive frames place the card top edge at y=540 pixels. No sampled vertical layout jump is observed while the drawer moves horizontally.

limits: The capture is variable-rate and holds unchanged screen images for long intervals; nominal frame rate is not a measurement of native rendering FPS.
The 16 full-resolution frames cover portions of opening and closing, not every instant in the 64-second video.
The stable y=540 result applies to the exposed card band in these frames; it does not certify all interactions, every page, or perceived animation smoothness.
